title: Development and Commissioning of VR Training Module for Pot Room Activities
scope_summary: Development of an enterprise-grade AR/VR training solution for safety, operations, and maintenance activities at NALCO's Pot Line, Angul Smelter Plant. The solution must include hardware, software, and integration services for immersive training in critical plant areas like Pot Room activities, anode change processes, and emergency workflows.

title: GIS BASED INTEGRATED AIRPORT ASSET MANAGEMENT SYSTEM at Cochin International Airport (including 6 years AMC)
scope_summary: Comprehensive data acquisition, processing, modelling, system integration, application development, deployment, training, and long-term support to implement an integrated GIS-based asset management platform for Cochin International Airport Limited (CIAL). The solution should include GIS-enabled asset management and operational solutions comprising mobile inspection applications, workflow and work-order management, indoor and outdoor navigation, and configurable role-based dashboards.

title: Survey and Updating of GIS-based Asset Data for Cochin International Airport
scope_summary: Comprehensive aerial survey, high-resolution photogrammetry, DGPS ground control surveys, and Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) surveys for accurate mapping of surface and subsurface utilities across the Cochin International Airport area. The acquired data will be processed and modeled to generate 2D/3D topographic maps, orthophotos, DEM/DSM, classified point clouds, and enterprise-grade GIS datasets.
